name: Druva MCP
description: Druva's MCP (Model Context Protocol) server is a secure gateway that lets compatible AI agents, such as Claude or Cursor, connect to your Druva Cloud account using your existing login permissions. Once connected via OAuth authentication, it lets you manage backups, review audit logs, and query environment health and metrics through natural-language prompts instead of the standard admin console. It respects your existing role-based access controls, so it can read and adjust configuration settings but cannot delete backup data or cloud configurations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Druva MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Druva MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-us.druva.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Druva MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Druva MCP provides these MCP tools: druva___list_skills, druva___recommend_skill, druva___retrieve_skill, and druva___run_script.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Druva MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Druva MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Druva MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Druva MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Druva MCP is developed by Druva Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
